Nodes.Name: MemFreq
Comments: It is userspace gov, powerhal will have exclusive and direct control of the freq

Nodes.Name: GEDDvfsMargin
Comments: GPU DVFS margin. Range per powercontable.xml: Min=1, Max=6553599, Default=329234.
Higher = GPU stays at high freq longer (conservative). Lower = drops faster (power saving).
Values 20/110/120/138 extracted from power_app_cfg.xml gaming app entries.

Nodes.Name: GEDLoadingDvfsStep
Comments: GPU loading-based DVFS step. Range per powercontable.xml: Min=0, Max=25855, Default=259.
Higher = GPU responds more aggressively to load spikes (performance). Lower = smoother, less reactive.
Value 8 extracted from power_app_cfg.xml gaming app entries (com.tencent.jkchess, com.netmarble.kofg).

Nodes.Name: UFSClkScale
Comments: UFS clock scaling control from powercontable.xml PERF_RES_IO_UFS_CLKSCALE.
Enabling clkscale=0 during idle/inactive saves significant power.

Nodes.Name: DCSMode
Comments: GPU Dynamic Clock Scaling mode. Range per powercontable.xml: Min=0, Max=66, Default=64.
64=stock default (DCS on, standard mode), 66=max DCS (most aggressive power-save scaling).
32/16=intermediate modes, 0=DCS off (GPU clocks freely, no dynamic scaling).
Use 66 for sustained load/gaming to reduce GPU idle power, 64 for balanced, 0 for FIXED_PERFORMANCE.

Actions.Comments: Reduced from 1000000@1000ms. INTERACTION fires on every touch/scroll - 1s pin at 1GHz caused major drain.
Reduced from 2100000@1000ms. Was pinning mid cluster nearly 3x higher than needed for UI responsiveness.
Reduced from 2200000@1000ms. Big core at 1.6GHz is sufficient for responsive UI interactions.
Stock default margin during touch - let GPU respond normally to interaction load spikes.
Stock default DVFS step during touch - standard GPU reactivity.
Stock DCS mode during interaction - balanced, not restricting GPU during touch response.
Balanced UFS clock scaling during interaction.
Reduced duration from 5000ms to 3000ms. Max freq cap stays same.
Reduced from 3250000@2000ms. 2.7GHz is still very responsive for app launch.
Reduced from 2900000@2000ms.
Reduced from 2000000@2000ms.
Reduced duration from 5000ms to 3000ms. Max memory freq still provided for fast load.
Reduced duration from 5000ms to 3000ms.
Slightly relaxed from index 6 (1144MHz) to index 8 (1092MHz). Saves ~50mW over the burst.
GPU DVFS margin (Min=1, Max=6553599, Default=329234) - lower=faster GPU downscale
GPU loading DVFS step (Min=0, Max=25855, Default=259) - lower=smoother GPU scaling
GPU Dynamic Clock Scaling mode (Min=0, Max=66, Default=64) - 66=max power-save DCS
UFS clock scaling (0=aggressive, 1=balanced, 2=performance)
Max margin - GPU never drops during fixed performance mode. Range max per powercontable.xml.
Max DVFS step - GPU responds instantly to any load during fixed performance. Range max per powercontable.xml.
Disable DCS in fixed performance - let GPU clock freely without dynamic scaling constraints.
UFS clock scaling (0=aggressive, 1=balanced, 2=performance)
Reduced from 2000000. Stock OEM gaming apps (powercontable/app_cfg) use 1500-1800MHz for little cluster.
Reduced from 2900000. 2.1GHz sustained mid minimum prevents thermal throttle over long gaming sessions.
Reduced from 3250000 (ABSOLUTE MAX). 3.25GHz sustained causes throttle within minutes. 2.4GHz is optimal sustained.
Relaxed from index 3 (1222MHz) to index 5 (1170MHz). GED DVFS handles burst needs. Saves ~150mW sustained.
Reduced from 50. Letting GED auto-manage GPU boost during gaming is more power-efficient than 50% forced floor.
Gaming-tuned GPU DVFS margin from power_app_cfg.xml. Allows GPU to drop freq faster when not needed vs stock 329234.
Smooth GPU DVFS stepping for gaming from power_app_cfg.xml. Lower than stock 259 = GPU scales more gradually.
Max DCS (66) during gaming - aggressive GPU dynamic clock scaling reduces sustained heat and power draw.
Reduced from 40. Uclamp 30 is sufficient; app_cfg stock OEM entries don't rely on global uclamp min for gaming.
UFS clock scaling (0=aggressive, 1=balanced, 2=performance)
Relaxed from index 10 (1040MHz) to index 12 (988MHz). Sufficient for sustained rendering with GED headroom.
Reduced from 2200000. Sustained 2.2GHz big core for rendering is excessive and hot.
Reduced from 2000000.
Reduced from 1300000.
Reduced from 4218000000. Sufficient memory BW for most rendering workloads.
Moderate GPU DVFS margin during rendering - from power_app_cfg.xml gaming tuning. Allows GPU to drop when idle.
Smooth GPU DVFS stepping during rendering - from power_app_cfg.xml. Prevents GPU from spiking unnecessarily.
Max DCS during sustained rendering - GPU dynamically scales on idle frames to save power and reduce heat.
Balanced UFS scaling during rendering - not fully aggressive to avoid storage latency spikes.
Most aggressive GPU downscaling margin in low power mode. From power_app_cfg.xml (com.tencent.jkchess @60fps). Min=1, Max=6553599.
Zero DVFS step in low power - GPU frequency changes minimally under light load. Min per powercontable.xml.
Max DCS power saving in low power mode. Max=66 per powercontable.xml.
Enable aggressive UFS clock scaling in low power mode per powercontable.xml PERF_RES_IO_UFS_CLKSCALE.
Low margin during camera launch burst - GPU should ramp up quickly for viewfinder/preview init.
Higher DVFS step during camera launch - GPU responds aggressively to load for fast preview start.
Disable DCS during camera launch burst - let GPU clock freely for maximum responsiveness.
Full UFS performance during camera launch - fast storage access needed for camera lib loading.
Aggressive GPU downscaling during display idle. Min=1, Max=6553599.
Max DCS when display idle. Max=66 per powercontable.xml.
GPU loading DVFS step (Min=0, Max=25855, Default=259) - lower=smoother GPU scaling
UFS clock scaling (0=aggressive, 1=balanced, 2=performance)
Aggressive GPU downclocking when screen off. Min=1, Max=6553599, Default=329234.
Minimal GPU DVFS step when display off - GPU almost static at low freq.
Max DCS when display off. Max=66 per powercontable.xml.
Enable UFS clock scaling when display is off for power saving.
Reduced from 2100000. At 120Hz this fires every 8.3ms - the SINGLE BIGGEST heat source. 1.5GHz is adequate.
Reduced from 2000000. Critical fix - mid cluster was being pinned at 2GHz minimum per frame at 120fps.
Reduced from 2500000. Was forcing big core to 2.5GHz every single frame at 120Hz = constant high load.
Relaxed from index 8 (1092MHz) - unchanged, this was already reasonable.
Reduced from 5480000000. 4.2GHz memory is plenty for a single frame draw window.
Moderate GPU DVFS margin per frame. From power_app_cfg.xml (com.tencent.cf @60fps). Balances responsiveness vs power.
Stock default DVFS step during frame render window - responsive but not excessive.
GPU Dynamic Clock Scaling mode (Min=0, Max=66, Default=64) - 66=max power-save DCS
UFS clock scaling (0=aggressive, 1=balanced, 2=performance)
Stock default GPU DVFS margin during display change - let GPU handle transition load normally.
Stock default DVFS step during display change - normal GPU reactivity for transition.
Stock DCS mode during display change - standard balanced mode, not restricting GPU during transition.
Balanced UFS scaling during display change transition.
Reduced from 2800000. 2.2GHz is sufficient for display mode transitions.
Reduced from 2700000.
Reduced from 1700000.
Reduced from 7500000000. 6.4GHz memory sufficient for display transition.
